senses.en: a legal process to settle a dispute in court
senses.pattern: take legal action / bring an action against sb / a court action
senses.example: The tenants brought an [[action]] against the landlord, who had refused to return their deposits for months.
senses.example_zh: 房東好幾個月都拒絕退還押金，房客們於是對他提起訴訟。
senses.note: legal action 不可數；an action 可數

senses.en: the effect one thing has on another
senses.pattern: the action of the waves / the action of acid on metal / by the action of sunlight
senses.example: Over thousands of years, the [[action]] of wind and rain carved these rocks into strange shapes.
senses.example_zh: 數千年來，風和雨的作用把這些岩石雕刻成奇特的形狀。

gsat.sentence: They lick the rails to pick up iron filings caused by the [[action]] of wheels against tracks.

senses.en: (of a plan) needing great effort, money, or skill to succeed
senses.pattern: an ambitious plan / an ambitious project / an overly ambitious goal
senses.example: Building a tunnel under the sea was an [[ambitious]] project that took engineers over twenty years to finish.
senses.example_zh: 興建海底隧道是一項宏大艱鉅的工程，工程師花了二十多年才完成。
senses.note: 此義修飾事物（計畫、目標），非修飾人

gsat.sentence: A triumph for medical technology, Oddsson’s fish skin transplantation was actually part of the astonishing achievement of “100% Fish,” an [[ambitious]] task in promoting environmental efficiency.
Medvedev Vladimir, 43, and his son, Maxsine, 14, sailed from an unnamed eastern Russian seaport on August 18, to begin an [[ambitious]] around-the-world cruise.

senses.en: to deal with or take care of someone or something
senses.pattern: attend to a customer / attend to one's duties / attend to sb's needs / attend to the wounded
senses.example: The nurse said she would [[attend]] to the injured cyclist as soon as she finished with another patient.
senses.example_zh: 護士說，她一忙完另一位病人，就會過來照料那位受傷的單車騎士。
senses.note: 與 to 連用；及物 attend a patient＝看護病人

gsat.sentence: Many of his works—depictions of children at play and in school, farm girls [[attending]] to their work, hunters and their prey—have become classic images of nineteenth-century American life.
Dooley keeps Peanuts company while the adults in the family [[attend]] to Grandfather.

senses.en: in front of or in the presence of someone
senses.pattern: appear before a judge / speak before an audience / before one's eyes
senses.example: The young inventor had to explain her design [[before]] a panel of five judges.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕的發明家必須在五位評審面前說明她的設計。

senses.en: more important than something else
senses.pattern: put A before B / come before everything else / put quality before quantity
senses.example: A good captain always puts the safety of the passengers [[before]] his own.
senses.example_zh: 好的船長總是把乘客的安全看得重於自己的安危。

gsat.sentence: As a shy boy afraid of making public appearances, Timmy dreads the thought of speaking [[before]] large audiences.

His vivid paintings brought the splendor of the extraordinary landscapes [[before]] the eyes of American people, thus setting the stage for the regions to be widely recognized and officially established as national parks.

senses.en: a local office or shop of a large organization
senses.pattern: a bank branch / open a new branch / the local branch
senses.example: The bookstore chain plans to open a new [[branch]] near our school next spring.
senses.example_zh: 這家連鎖書店計劃明年春天在我們學校附近開一家新分店。

senses.en: a division of a larger subject or area of knowledge
senses.pattern: a branch of science / a branch of medicine / a branch of mathematics
senses.example: Geometry is the [[branch]] of mathematics that deals with shapes, lines, and angles.
senses.example_zh: 幾何學是數學的一個分支，研究的是形狀、線條與角度。

gsat.sentence: There are three [[branches]] of medicine.

senses.en: (of a shop) to have a product for sale
senses.pattern: carry a wide range of / carry a brand / carry organic products
senses.example: I'm afraid we don't [[carry]] that size, but the store across the street might have it.
senses.example_zh: 我們恐怕沒有販售那個尺寸，不過對街那家店可能有。

senses.en: to involve a particular risk, penalty, or result
senses.pattern: carry a risk / carry a heavy fine / carry a warning / carry weight
senses.example: Every operation [[carries]] some risk, so the surgeon explained the procedure to the family in detail.
senses.example_zh: 每項手術都帶有一些風險，所以外科醫師向家屬詳細說明了手術過程。

senses.en: (of media) to include a news story or program
senses.pattern: carry a story / carry a report / carry the game live
senses.example: All the major newspapers [[carried]] the story of the rescue on their front pages the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 隔天早上，各大報都在頭版刊登了這則救援行動的報導。

gsat.sentence: From fashion items to rice snacks, it [[carries]] products only from local makers and small businesses owned by indigenous people.
Nor is it one of the cable networks such as CNN, which [[carries]] only news and news stories.

senses.en: plates, cups, and bowls made of fine white clay
senses.pattern: fine china / a china cup / a set of china / bone china
senses.example: Grandma only takes out her best [[china]] when important guests come to dinner.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶只有在貴客來吃晚餐時，才會拿出她最好的瓷器。
senses.note: 小寫、不可數；大寫 China 才指中國

senses.en: the series of numbers used to open a lock
senses.pattern: a combination lock / the combination to the safe / forget the combination
senses.example: Only the manager knows the [[combination]] to the safe where the day's cash is kept.
senses.example_zh: 只有經理知道保險箱的密碼，當天收到的現金都存放在裡面。
senses.note: combination lock：密碼鎖、對號鎖

senses.en: staying the same; not changing
senses.pattern: a constant temperature / a constant speed / remain constant
senses.example: The museum's storage room is kept at a [[constant]] temperature of eighteen degrees all year round.
senses.example_zh: 博物館的儲藏室全年維持在十八度的恆定溫度。

senses.en: a number or thing that never changes
senses.pattern: a mathematical constant / a physical constant / the one constant in sb's life
senses.example: In a world of rapid change, my grandmother's kindness has been the one [[constant]] in my life.
senses.example_zh: 在瞬息萬變的世界裡，奶奶的慈愛一直是我生命中唯一不變的事物。

senses.en: (of a computer or system) to suddenly stop working
senses.pattern: the computer crashed / the system crashed / the website keeps crashing
senses.example: My laptop [[crashed]] right before I saved the report, so I had to type everything again.
senses.example_zh: 我的筆電就在我存檔前當機了，所以整份報告都得重打。

senses.en: a sudden large fall in prices or value
senses.pattern: a stock market crash / a financial crash / a crash in house prices
senses.example: Thousands of investors lost their life savings in the stock market [[crash]] of 1929.
senses.example_zh: 數千名投資人在一九二九年的股市崩盤中賠光了畢生積蓄。
senses.note: 另：a crash course＝速成課程

senses.en: a long period of very low economic activity
senses.pattern: an economic depression / the Great Depression / a severe depression
senses.example: During the [[depression]], many factories closed and millions of workers could not find jobs.
senses.example_zh: 經濟蕭條期間，許多工廠倒閉，數百萬名工人找不到工作。
senses.note: the Great Depression：1930 年代經濟大蕭條

senses.en: an area of low air pressure, often bringing rain
senses.pattern: a tropical depression / a deep depression / an approaching depression
senses.example: A tropical [[depression]] east of the island is expected to bring heavy rain this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 島嶼東方的熱帶性低氣壓預計本週末將帶來豪雨。
senses.note: 也可指地面的「窪地、凹陷處」

senses.en: to clean a wound and cover it with a bandage
senses.pattern: dress a wound / dress a cut / dress a burn
senses.example: The school nurse cleaned the cut on my knee and [[dressed]] it with a clean bandage.
senses.example_zh: 校護清洗我膝蓋上的傷口，並用乾淨的繃帶包紮起來。
senses.note: 名詞 dressing：敷料；沙拉醬

senses.en: clothes of a particular type or for an occasion
senses.pattern: formal dress / casual dress / traditional dress / a dress code
senses.example: Guests at the festival were invited to wear the traditional [[dress]] of their own countries.
senses.example_zh: 主辦單位邀請參加節慶的賓客穿上各自國家的傳統服裝。
senses.note: 此義不可數

gsat.sentence: Only 4 percent of employers said that casual [[dress]] has a negative impact on productivity.

senses.en: to attract and keep someone's attention or interest
senses.pattern: engage sb's attention / engage sb's interest / engage the audience
senses.example: A good science teacher knows how to [[engage]] students' interest with simple experiments.
senses.example_zh: 好的自然科老師懂得用簡單的實驗吸引學生的興趣。
senses.note: 形容詞 engaging：吸引人的、迷人的

senses.en: to hire someone to do a particular job
senses.pattern: engage a lawyer / engage a tutor / engage sb as a guide / engage the services of
senses.example: The film crew [[engaged]] a local guide to lead them through the mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 劇組聘用了一位當地嚮導，帶他們走訪山區的村落。

senses.en: to let someone down when they need you
senses.pattern: fail one's family / never fail a friend / words fail me
senses.example: He felt he had [[failed]] his teammates by missing the final shot of the game.
senses.example_zh: 他覺得自己沒投進比賽的最後一球，辜負了隊友。

senses.en: to become weak or stop working properly
senses.pattern: failing eyesight / failing health / the brakes failed / the engine failed
senses.example: Although her eyesight is [[failing]], my great-aunt still enjoys listening to audiobooks every evening.
senses.example_zh: 雖然姑婆的視力日漸衰退，她每天晚上仍然喜歡聽有聲書。

senses.en: very thin or small; delicate, subtle, or precise
senses.pattern: fine sand / fine hair / a fine line / fine details
senses.example: The old books were covered with dust so [[fine]] that it rose into the air at the lightest touch.
senses.example_zh: 那些舊書上蒙著的灰塵非常細小，輕輕一碰就飛揚起來。

senses.en: money that must be paid as a punishment
senses.pattern: pay a fine / a heavy fine / a parking fine / a fine for littering
senses.example: Anyone caught littering in the national park must pay a [[fine]] of three thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 凡是在國家公園亂丟垃圾被抓到的人，必須繳交三千元罰款。

senses.en: to make someone pay money as a punishment
senses.pattern: be fined for speeding / fine sb $100 / be heavily fined
senses.example: The factory was [[fined]] heavily for pouring polluted water into the river.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠因為把污水排入河中，被處以鉅額罰款。

gsat.sentence: With a continuous 3 km stretch of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing sculptures with its [[fine]] soft sand.
Willig was honored in a party and [[fined]] only $1.10.

senses.en: to suddenly stop moving because of fear or shock
senses.pattern: freeze with fear / freeze in one's tracks / freeze on stage
senses.example: When the spotlight hit her, the young singer [[froze]] and forgot the first line of the song.
senses.example_zh: 聚光燈一打在她身上，年輕的歌手就僵住了，連第一句歌詞都忘了。
senses.note: 三態：freeze–froze–frozen

senses.en: to officially prevent money being used or prices rising
senses.pattern: freeze sb's assets / freeze a bank account / freeze prices / freeze wages
senses.example: The bank [[froze]] his account after noticing several strange payments made from overseas.
senses.example_zh: 銀行發現數筆來自海外的可疑付款後，便凍結了他的帳戶。

senses.en: a good reason for doing or believing something
senses.pattern: on the grounds that / on medical grounds / grounds for complaint / have no grounds for
senses.example: She was excused from the swimming class on medical [[grounds]] after her ear operation.
senses.example_zh: 她耳朵動過手術後，以健康理由獲准不上游泳課。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 grounds

senses.en: to stop a plane flying or a child going out
senses.pattern: ground all flights / be grounded by fog / be grounded for a week
senses.example: All flights were [[grounded]] for six hours because of thick fog over the airport.
senses.example_zh: 由於機場上空濃霧瀰漫，所有航班停飛了六個小時。
senses.note: ground 也是 grind（磨碎）的過去式

senses.en: to whatever degree; no matter how
senses.pattern: however hard you try / however small / however long it takes
senses.example: [[However]] carefully I explained the rules, my little brother still kept making the same mistake.
senses.example_zh: 無論我多麼仔細地解釋規則，我弟弟還是一直犯同樣的錯。
senses.note: 後面直接接形容詞或副詞，不加逗號

senses.en: in whatever way
senses.pattern: however you like / however you want / however you look at it
senses.example: You can arrange the photos on the poster [[however]] you like, as long as the title is clear.
senses.example_zh: 海報上的照片不管用什麼方式排列都可以，只要標題清楚就好。

senses.en: to own and take care of animals
senses.pattern: keep chickens / keep bees / keep a pet / keep goats
senses.example: My uncle [[keeps]] bees on his farm and sells the honey at the weekend market.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔在農場飼養蜜蜂，並在週末市集販售蜂蜜。

senses.en: (of food) to stay fresh and good to eat
senses.pattern: keep well / keep for a week / won't keep long
senses.example: Cooked rice does not [[keep]] well in hot weather, so eat it within a day.
senses.example_zh: 煮熟的米飯在大熱天裡不易保鮮，所以要在一天內吃完。

gsat.sentence: Is it a good idea to [[keep]] animals in sites not suited to them?

senses.en: (of a quality or problem) to exist or be found
senses.pattern: lie in / the problem lies in / the answer lies in / lie with
senses.example: The real strength of the team [[lies]] in its ability to stay calm under pressure.
senses.example_zh: 這支隊伍真正的實力在於能在壓力下保持冷靜。
senses.note: 三態 lie–lay–lain，不是 lied

senses.en: to be located in a particular place
senses.pattern: lie on the coast / lie to the north of / lie between
senses.example: The village [[lies]] at the foot of a volcano, about two hours from the nearest city.
senses.example_zh: 這座村莊位於一座火山的山腳下，距離最近的城市約兩小時車程。

gsat.sentence: The glory [[lies]] not in the achievement but in the sacrifice.
While it does have its share of resort hotels, shopping centers and good restaurants, and a smattering of museums, art galleries and night spots, its main attractions [[lie]] outdoors.

senses.en: to show that something important is happening
senses.pattern: mark the beginning of / mark the end of / mark a turning point
senses.example: The invention of the printing press [[marked]] the beginning of a new age of learning.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明標誌著一個新學習時代的開端。

senses.en: to celebrate or officially remember an important event
senses.pattern: mark the anniversary / mark the occasion / mark the centenary of
senses.example: The school planted a hundred trees to [[mark]] its one hundredth anniversary.
senses.example_zh: 學校種了一百棵樹來紀念創校一百週年。

gsat.sentence: The news made headlines around the world, not only for the incredible achievement of the search team, but because the discovery [[marked]] the final chapter in a legendary story of extraordinary courage and perseverance.

Last week Jay McCarroll and The HSUS (The Humane Society of the United States) made a bold fur-free statement on the runway, [[marking]] <u>a new chapter</u> for the fashion industry and animal protection.

senses.en: to base something on the design of something else
senses.pattern: be modeled on / be modeled after / model oneself on
senses.example: The new library was [[modeled]] on a famous reading room in an old European university.
senses.example_zh: 這座新圖書館是仿照一所歐洲古老大學裡著名的閱覽室建造的。
senses.note: 英式拼法：modelled

senses.en: a person or thing that is a good example to copy
senses.pattern: a model of efficiency / serve as a model for / a role model
senses.example: The city's recycling program has become a [[model]] for other towns hoping to reduce waste.
senses.example_zh: 該市的資源回收計畫已成為其他想減少垃圾的城鎮的典範。
senses.note: 作形容詞（名詞前）：a model student 模範生

gsat.sentence: Early table forks were [[modeled]] after kitchen forks, but small pieces of food often fell through the two tines or slipped off easily.
Following him, many local people opened their own bookshops, and the small town soon became a [[model]] of sustainable rural development and tourism.

senses.en: to mention something or notice it carefully
senses.pattern: note that / as noted above / it should be noted that / note the difference
senses.example: In her report, the researcher [[noted]] that the birds arrived two weeks earlier than usual.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員在報告中指出，這些鳥比往年早了兩個星期抵達。
senses.note: noted（adj.）著名的：be noted for

senses.en: a single musical sound, or the symbol for it
senses.pattern: a high note / a low note / hit a high note / play a wrong note
senses.example: The singer could not reach the highest [[note]] in the song, so she sang it an octave lower.
senses.example_zh: 那位歌手唱不上歌曲裡最高的那個音，於是降了八度來唱。

gsat.sentence: Some documents [[noted]] that Russians “indulge in excessive drinking whenever the occasion arises,” while others claimed that Russians “rarely drink wine.”
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree. As is often observed, most of us tend to associate lower [[notes]] with darker colors and higher notes with brighter colors.

senses.en: apart from that; in every other way
senses.pattern: an otherwise perfect day / otherwise healthy / otherwise excellent
senses.example: One spelling mistake spoiled an [[otherwise]] excellent essay about life in the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 這篇描寫鄉間生活的文章在其他方面都很出色，卻被一個拼字錯誤破壞了。

senses.en: differently; in another or opposite way
senses.pattern: think otherwise / say otherwise / prove otherwise / unless otherwise stated
senses.example: Everyone expected the old bridge to fall down, but the engineers' tests proved [[otherwise]].
senses.example_zh: 大家都以為那座老橋會倒塌，但工程師的測試卻證明事實正好相反。

senses.en: belonging only to one person, place, or thing
senses.pattern: be peculiar to / peculiar to the region / a problem peculiar to big cities
senses.example: The habit of bowing to the sea before fishing is [[peculiar]] to this small coastal town.
senses.example_zh: 出海捕魚前先向大海鞠躬，是這個濱海小鎮特有的習慣。
senses.note: 常用 be peculiar to＋地方／群體

senses.en: a secret plan to do something harmful or illegal
senses.pattern: a plot to overthrow / uncover a plot / a plot against the king
senses.example: The guards uncovered a [[plot]] to steal the crown jewels during the royal parade.
senses.example_zh: 衛兵揭發了一樁企圖在皇家遊行期間竊取王冠珠寶的陰謀。
senses.note: 亦作動詞：plot to do sth 密謀做某事

senses.en: a small piece of land used for a purpose
senses.pattern: a plot of land / a vegetable plot / a building plot
senses.example: Each family in the community garden is given a small [[plot]] to grow vegetables.
senses.example_zh: 社區菜園裡的每戶人家都分到一小塊土地來種菜。

senses.en: to mark points or a route on a graph or map
senses.pattern: plot a course / plot a graph / plot the data / plot points on a map
senses.example: The students measured the plant's height every day and [[plotted]] the results on a graph.
senses.example_zh: 學生每天測量植物的高度，並在圖表上標出結果。

gsat.sentence: I remember that on my cruise I was required to formally [[plot]] our course, using the tide table, even though our goal was an island I could see quite clearly across the water in the distance.

senses.en: something unpleasant suffered in order to get something
senses.pattern: pay a heavy price / at any price / the price of fame / a small price to pay
senses.example: Constant lack of sleep is the [[price]] many students pay for staying up to play online games.
senses.example_zh: 長期睡眠不足是許多學生熬夜玩線上遊戲所付出的代價。

senses.en: to set the amount of money something costs
senses.pattern: be priced at / reasonably priced / competitively priced / be priced too high
senses.example: The handmade notebooks are [[priced]] at two hundred dollars each, which most students can afford.
senses.example_zh: 這些手工筆記本每本定價兩百元，大多數學生都買得起。

senses.en: to continue to do an activity or study over time
senses.pattern: pursue a career in / pursue a degree / pursue further studies / pursue a hobby
senses.example: After high school, she moved to Vienna to [[pursue]] her studies in classical music.
senses.example_zh: 高中畢業後，她搬到維也納攻讀古典音樂。

senses.en: to continue to discuss or look into a matter
senses.pattern: pursue the matter / pursue the question / pursue a complaint / pursue the issue further
senses.example: Since the store agreed to give a full refund, we decided not to [[pursue]] the matter any further.
senses.example_zh: 既然商店同意全額退費，我們決定不再追究這件事。

gsat.sentence: Michael has decided to [[pursue]] a career in physics and has set his mind on becoming a professor.
Most young people in Taiwan are not satisfied with a high school diploma and continue to [[pursue]] further education in college.

senses.en: to think carefully and deeply about something
senses.pattern: reflect on / reflect on one's mistakes / time to reflect
senses.example: At the end of each semester, our teacher asks us to [[reflect]] on what we have learned.
senses.example_zh: 每學期結束時，老師都會要我們靜下心來深思這學期學到了什麼。
senses.note: 名詞 reflection：深思、反省

senses.en: a group of people working together secretly and illegally
senses.pattern: a drug ring / a spy ring / a smuggling ring / break up a ring
senses.example: Police broke up a [[ring]] that had been smuggling rare parrots out of the rainforest.
senses.example_zh: 警方破獲了一個將稀有鸚鵡走私出雨林的不法集團。

senses.en: an enclosed area where boxers fight or circus acts perform
senses.pattern: a boxing ring / a circus ring / step into the ring
senses.example: The crowd cheered wildly as the two boxers stepped into the [[ring]] for the final match.
senses.example_zh: 兩位拳擊手踏上拳擊台準備進行決賽時，觀眾瘋狂歡呼。

senses.en: a circle, or a group of things forming a circle
senses.pattern: a ring of trees / form a ring / sit in a ring / a ring of fire
senses.example: The children sat in a [[ring]] around the storyteller and listened without making a sound.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們圍著說故事的人坐成一個圓圈，安安靜靜地聽著。

gsat.sentence: When the main tree dies, the sprouts are then free to grow as full trees, forming a “fairy [[ring]]” of trees around the initial tree.

senses.en: to test or check people for a disease or suitability
senses.pattern: screen for cancer / be screened for / screen passengers / screen applicants
senses.example: All newborn babies in the hospital are [[screened]] for hearing problems before they go home.
senses.example_zh: 這家醫院所有的新生兒在回家前都要接受聽力篩檢。
senses.note: 名詞 screening：篩檢；放映

senses.en: to show a film or television program
senses.pattern: screen a film / screen a documentary / be screened on TV
senses.example: The documentary about sea turtles will be [[screened]] in the school hall this Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 這部關於海龜的紀錄片將於本週五下午在學校禮堂放映。

senses.en: one of the equal parts a company is divided into
senses.pattern: buy shares / sell shares / share prices / shares in a company
senses.example: He bought a few [[shares]] in the bicycle company when it was still small and unknown.
senses.example_zh: 那家自行車公司還規模很小、沒沒無聞時，他就買了一些股份。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 shares

senses.en: one person's part of something divided among several people
senses.pattern: do one's share / a fair share of / market share / one's share of the blame
senses.example: If everyone does their [[share]] of the housework, the apartment will stay clean and tidy.
senses.example_zh: 如果每個人都做好自己應分擔的那一份家事，公寓就能保持乾淨整齊。

gsat.sentence: He realizes that only by cooperating can he do his [[share]] in making society what it should be.
Although about 90 percent of American households still use film cameras, digital cameras are capturing a growing [[share]] of the consumer market.

senses.en: to treat someone rudely or without proper respect
senses.pattern: feel slighted / slight a guest / be slighted by
senses.example: She felt [[slighted]] when the host greeted everyone at the table except her.
senses.example_zh: 主人跟同桌的每個人打招呼，唯獨漏了她，讓她覺得受到怠慢。
senses.note: 亦作名詞：a slight on sb 對某人的怠慢

senses.en: small and thin in build
senses.pattern: a slight figure / of slight build / a slight young woman
senses.example: Despite her [[slight]] build, the gymnast was strong enough to lift her own weight with one arm.
senses.example_zh: 這位體操選手雖然身材瘦小，卻強壯得能單手撐起自己的體重。

senses.en: to drive faster than the legal limit
senses.pattern: be caught speeding / be fined for speeding / a speeding ticket
senses.example: The driver was stopped by the police because he had been [[speeding]] in a school zone.
senses.example_zh: 那名駕駛因為在學校附近的路段超速行駛而被警察攔下。
senses.note: 此義常用進行式

senses.en: to make something happen more quickly
senses.pattern: speed recovery / speed the process / speed up production / speed things up
senses.example: Doctors say that a balanced diet and enough rest can [[speed]] recovery after surgery.
senses.example_zh: 醫生說，均衡飲食與充足休息能加快手術後的復原。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞：sped 或 speeded

gsat.sentence: For example, an injured runner might end up cycling and swimming instead of running. Their consensus, however, is that unless the injury involves something as serious as a broken bone or a ripped muscle, moderate exercise can actually [[speed]] healing.
You might [[speed]] up healing time by gently pressing a warm washcloth against your eyelid for 10 minutes, 3 or 4 times a day.

senses.en: a supply of goods available for sale in a shop
senses.pattern: in stock / out of stock / while stocks last / a large stock of
senses.example: The red sneakers are out of [[stock]] now, but new ones will arrive next week.
senses.example_zh: 紅色運動鞋目前沒有存貨，不過下星期會進新貨。

senses.en: to keep a supply of something to sell or use
senses.pattern: stock a wide range of / be well stocked / stock up on / stock the shelves
senses.example: The corner shop [[stocks]] everything from fresh bread to bicycle tires.
senses.example_zh: 街角那家小店備有各種貨品，從新鮮麵包到腳踏車輪胎都買得到。

gsat.sentence: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost bare and the [[stock]] nearly gone.
But because the potatoes had to be peeled by hand, it was a time-consuming chore and potato chips were often out of [[stock]].

senses.en: a slight sign that something is true or exists
senses.pattern: there is no suggestion that / any suggestion of cheating / a strong suggestion that
senses.example: The police said there was no [[suggestion]] that the fire had been started on purpose.
senses.example_zh: 警方表示，沒有跡象顯示這場火災是有人蓄意縱火。

senses.en: a very small amount or slight trace of something
senses.pattern: a suggestion of a smile / a suggestion of sadness / a suggestion of garlic
senses.example: There was only a [[suggestion]] of a smile on his face when he heard the good news.
senses.example_zh: 聽到好消息時，他臉上只露出一絲微笑。
senses.note: 常用 a suggestion of＋名詞

senses.en: to know or recognize something, or see a difference
senses.pattern: tell A from B / tell the difference / can tell that / tell A and B apart
senses.example: The twins look so alike that even their teachers cannot [[tell]] one from the other.
senses.example_zh: 這對雙胞胎長得太像，連老師都無法分辨誰是誰。
senses.note: 常與 can / could 連用

senses.en: to have a noticeable, often harmful, effect
senses.pattern: tell on sb / begin to tell / the strain tells on sb
senses.example: After three weeks of exams, the lack of sleep was beginning to [[tell]] on the students.
senses.example_zh: 考了三個星期的試之後，睡眠不足開始對學生產生明顯影響。

gsat.sentence: It is easy for us to [[tell]] our friends from our enemies.

senses.en: to find the origin or cause of something
senses.pattern: trace sth back to / trace the origin of / trace one's roots / be traced to
senses.example: The family has [[traced]] its history back to a fishing village on the northern coast.
senses.example_zh: 這個家族把自家的歷史追溯到北海岸的一座漁村。

senses.en: a very small amount of something
senses.pattern: traces of poison / a trace of a smile / trace amounts of
senses.example: Tests found [[traces]] of a dangerous chemical in the water from the village well.
senses.example_zh: 檢驗發現村裡的井水含有微量的危險化學物質。

gsat.sentence: One of these stories [[traces]] the cookie’s origin back to 13th- and 14th-century China, which was then occupied by the Mongols.
The territorial dispute can be [[traced]] back to the year 1917, when the two countries were at war.

senses.en: to think that something is important or precious
senses.pattern: value sb's opinion / value friendship / be highly valued / value A over B
senses.example: A good coach [[values]] effort and teamwork more than the final score.
senses.example_zh: 好教練重視努力與團隊合作，勝過最後的比數。

senses.en: beliefs about what is right and important in life
senses.pattern: family values / traditional values / moral values / share the same values
senses.example: Although the two friends grew up in different countries, they share many of the same [[values]].
senses.example_zh: 這兩位朋友雖然在不同的國家長大，卻有許多相同的價值觀。
senses.note: 此義恆用複數 values

gsat.sentence: Paintings with white-toothed smiles emerged after the 1700s, with the gradual rise of a culture that [[valued]] perception and responsiveness.
A search for African American [[values]].

senses.en: considering the fact that; since
senses.pattern: how can … when … / why … when … / what's the point when …
senses.example: How can you expect to pass the test [[when]] you never open your textbook?
senses.example_zh: 既然你從來不翻開課本，怎麼能指望通過考試呢？

senses.en: although; despite the fact that
senses.pattern: when in fact / when actually / when sb could have done
senses.example: She walked all the way home in the rain [[when]] she could easily have taken the bus.
senses.example_zh: 她明明可以輕鬆搭公車，卻一路淋雨走回家。

quiz.stem: Before being allowed to donate blood, all volunteers are carefully ______ for infectious diseases to make sure the blood is safe for patients.
quiz.explain_zh: screen＝篩檢。捐血前，所有自願捐血者都須接受傳染病篩檢，以確保血液安全。

quiz.stem: The committee rejected the proposal to build a new swimming pool on the ______ that it would cost far more than the school could afford.
quiz.explain_zh: ground＝理由、根據。委員會以花費遠超過學校所能負擔為由否決提案。

quiz.stem: This species of butterfly is ______ to the high mountains of the island and has never been seen anywhere else in the world.
quiz.explain_zh: peculiar＝特有的。這種蝴蝶是島上高山所特有，別處從未見過。

quiz.stem: The small pharmacy near my house doesn't ______ the vitamin brand my doctor recommended, so I had to order it online.
quiz.explain_zh: carry＝販售、備有。家附近的藥局沒賣醫生推薦的維他命，只好上網訂購。

quiz.stem: The outbreak of food poisoning was eventually ______ to a batch of undercooked chicken served in the school cafeteria.
quiz.explain_zh: trace＝追溯、查出。食物中毒最後查出是源自學校餐廳沒煮熟的雞肉。

quiz.stem: The weather bureau warned that a tropical ______ forming over the ocean could strengthen into a typhoon within two days.
quiz.explain_zh: depression＝低氣壓。氣象局警告海面上的熱帶性低氣壓可能增強為颱風。

quiz.stem: The weather forecast promised sunshine all weekend, but the dark clouds gathering over the mountains suggested ______.
quiz.explain_zh: otherwise＝相反地。預報說整個週末放晴，但山頭聚集的烏雲顯示情況並非如此。

quiz.stem: After months of investigation, police finally arrested the leaders of a ______ that had been selling fake concert tickets online.
quiz.explain_zh: ring＝（不法）集團。警方逮捕了在網路上販售假演唱會門票的集團首腦。

quiz.stem: Whenever the teacher asks him to speak in front of the whole class, Kevin ______ and cannot say a single word.
quiz.explain_zh: freeze＝（因緊張、恐懼）僵住。Kevin 一被要求在全班面前說話就僵住，說不出話。

quiz.stem: According to the coach, the secret of the team's success ______ not in any single star player but in the trust among all its members.
quiz.explain_zh: lie＝在於。教練認為球隊成功的祕訣在於全體隊員的互信，而非單一明星球員。
